item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsang chen gyi brgyud 'debs
item.coloph: ces spyi spungs gab pa gsang chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul 'di yang / rgod rje rgya yi gdung la dal rten rnyed pa'i kho bo g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bdag kyang / dbal gshen stag la dngos byon dbal 'bar stag slag can gyi bka' lha dbang phyag gi nor bu lta bu la/ mos gus gting nas skye ba dang*/ phyis su bka' yi gnang ba yang yang thob pa bzhin du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab ste smin grol mthar rgyas gling du sug bris bgyis pa'o//
